comments.author: @quintediminuee
comments.text:
There is a tendency for French people to suddenly act besties with someone you just met, but it's not actually very deep and can quickly fall apart.

There's a nuance in the language between "pote" (buddy) and "ami" (friend). You will more easily call people your "potes" than your "amis", kinda like "I like you" vs. "I love you".

"Real" friendship does indeed take some extra time to form for us, and how long you've know each other for definitely plays a role in friendships ranking.

The French's true friend is the one you can call when things get really ugly and who will come and get you no matter how weird or unusual or unpractical the situation is. That's the one we'll be naming our first born after.
